title: centaurea solstitialis subsp. adami
intro: Centaurea solstitialis subsp. adami, commonly known as Adam's knapweed, is a subspecies of the perennial plant Centaurea solstitialis, belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Adam's knapweed include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents present in Adam's knapweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
